QF.id: VIII Introduction to Clearing and Settlement System_60

question.text: The notional value of 3 lots of Bank Nifty futures at 48,000 with a lot size of 15 is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Step-by-step: 1. Notional value per lot = Price x Lot size = 48,000 x 15 = Rs. 7,20,000 2. Total notional value = 7,20,000 x 3 lots = Rs. 21,60,000 The Trap: Rs. 7,20,000 is for 1 lot only. Make sure to multiply by the number of lots. Cross-Exam Context: Contract value/notional value calculations are the foundation for margin calculations. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Notional value = Price x Lot size x Number of lots. This is the basis for all margin calculations.
